e1fa8448f73d1f02.description: About the Role Algihaz Holding is seeking a Testing Engineer to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires an engineer with substantial experience in testing and commissioning electrical systems and equipment, ensuring operational reliability and compliance with standards. Key Responsibilities Perform testing and commissioning for Auxiliary, Trip, and Lockout Relays. Conduct ACDB and DCDB scheme checks and testing. Execute protection relay testing for various types including line differential, transformer differential, busbar, and OC/EF relays. Handle protection relays from multiple manufacturers such as SIEMENS, ABB, and Schneider Electric. Configure protection relays and prepare CID files. Test MV, HV, and EHV primary equipment, including GIS and outdoor systems (CT, VT, CB, MCCB), and perform high voltage tests. Conduct scheme, functional, and interlock checks for LCC Panels, Protection Panels, and Control Panels. Perform transformer testing and commissioning. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor of Engineering ( or Bachelor of Technology (** in Electrical Engineering or a related field. A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in testing and commissioning. Demonstrated experience in Auxiliary/Trip/Lockout Relay testing. Proficiency in ACDB and DCDB scheme checking and testing. Experience with various protection relays and handling equipment from major manufacturers. Knowledge of protection relay configuration and CID file preparation. Experience in testing MV, HV, EHV primary equipment, including GIS and outdoor systems. Experience with LCC Panel, Protection Panel, and Control Panel checks. Experience in transformer testing and commissioning. Required Skills and Attributes Ability to learn new skills and adapt to new responsibilities. Strong critical thinking and analytical skills. Ability to work cooperatively within a team environment. Work Environment This role requires a willingness to travel across Saudi Arabia to various project sites as needed for testing and commissioning activities.

e12aad971ca54bf1.description: About the Role Harry Winston is seeking a Retail Operations Specialist to join its team in Makkah, with responsibilities covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on overseeing and coordinating boutique operational activities to ensure seamless daily operations, inventory accuracy, and compliance with brand standards. The specialist supports the Salon Manager in maintaining operational controls and safeguarding assets to ensure a flawless luxury client experience. Key Responsibilities Ensure smooth execution of daily boutique operations, including opening and closing activities, and maintain operational readiness. Monitor compliance with boutique operational procedures and identify operational risks, recommending corrective actions. Manage inventory and stock control, including monitoring stock accuracy, coordinating stock movements, and supporting inventory reconciliations and audits. Ensure proper documentation of inventory transactions and escalate discrepancies immediately. Ensure adherence to company policies, brand procedures, and security protocols, supporting internal and external audit requirements. Maintain operational records and documentation, and ensure proper execution of approval processes. Ensure compliance with boutique presentation standards, monitor housekeeping and hospitality, and support VM and boutique setup guidelines. Support the sales team in delivering client experiences, coordinating operational requirements for client appointments and events, and ensuring product availability. Maintain operational trackers and reports, monitor key operational metrics, and prepare inventory and compliance reports. Performance Indicators Key performance will be measured against metrics including: Inventory Control: Inventory Accuracy %, Stock Reconciliation Accuracy, Inventory Variance Rate. Operational Excellence: Audit Compliance Score, Operational Process Compliance, Timely Completion of Operational Tasks. Boutique Standards: Boutique Readiness Score, VM Compliance, Hospitality Standards Compliance. Risk & Control: Zero Critical Inventory Discrepancies, Zero Operational Control Violations, Timely Resolution of Operational Issues. Authority and Decision Making The Retail Operations Specialist coordinates daily operational activities and escalates inventory discrepancies and control issues. The role includes recommending operational improvements and supporting operational decision-making within approved procedures. This position does not hold authority over pricing, discounts, or commercial decisions. Working Relationships This role involves close collaboration with internal teams including the Salon Manager, Vault Coordinator, Sales Team, Finance, and Brand Manager. External interactions may include auditors, logistics partners, and mall management as required. Key Challenges Challenges for this role include maintaining inventory accuracy in a high-value luxury environment, ensuring operational compliance without impacting client experience, supporting business operations while maintaining strict control standards, and managing operational risks and asset protection requirements.

e15c9ebf99f10e87.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager - Asset Operations SU7 to join its team. This full-time role involves managing City Operations assets as they transition from delivery into live operations. The successful candidate will coordinate readiness planning, mobilisation, training, and handover evidence, focusing on early identification of gaps and preparing receiving teams for a controlled operational transition. Key Responsibilities Develop asset-level readiness plans aligned with delivery milestones, phased handovers, and opening dates, tracking dependencies, owners, and completion evidence. Coordinate operational design reviews covering access, maintainability, cleanability, service routes, storage, and operational support needs. Confirm service boundaries, operating responsibilities, and interfaces, escalating ownership gaps and unresolved dependencies. Coordinate mobilisation of service providers, staffing, equipment, consumables, procedures, and support facilities. Track handover documentation and coordinate asset-data, CAFM workflow, and planned-maintenance readiness with responsible specialists. Arrange training, operational walkthroughs, scenario-based trials, and joint inspections, tracking corrective actions and closure evidence. Maintain readiness registers, risk logs, and evidence packs, providing recommendations for handover and opening gates without assuming technical certification or final acceptance authority. Transfer readiness records, outstanding actions, and approved interim arrangements to receiving teams, supporting initial operational stabilisation. Qualifications and Experience A degree in facilities management, engineering, construction management, asset management, operations management, or a related discipline. Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in facilities management, asset operations, operational readiness, or project-to-operations transition. At least 2 years of experience managing or coordinating readiness, mobilisation, or handover workstreams. Practical experience in preparing new properties, public realm, infrastructure, or mixed-use assets for operational handover, including coordinating delivery teams, technical specialists, and receiving operators. Experience in maintaining readiness plans, verifying evidence, tracking defects and dependencies, escalating blockers, and supporting transition into live operations. Preferred Qualifications Relevant recognised certification in facilities management, asset management, or project management is preferred. Training in operational readiness, commissioning and handover, or health and safety is advantageous. Work Type This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

e17141d79ca2e659.description: About the Opportunity TRS Staffing Solutions is seeking a Senior Estimator for a contract opportunity in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This role supports complex plant modifications, revamps, expansions, and turnaround projects within the petrochemical and refinery sectors. Role Overview The Senior Estimator will be responsible for developing various types of cost estimates for projects, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established methodologies. This position requires a strong background in cost estimating within industrial environments, particularly those involving live plant operations. Key Responsibilities Prepare conceptual estimates for early project phases. Develop Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) estimates. Formulate definitive estimates for project execution. Required Qualifications and Experience 12–15+ years of experience in cost estimating. Proven experience with conceptual, FEED, and definitive estimate preparation. Exposure to brownfield and live-plant projects. Knowledge of AACE estimating methodology. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in the Middle East region. Certification such as CCP (Certified Cost Professional), CEP (Certified Estimating Professional), or PSP (Planning and Scheduling Professional). Work Type and Location This is a contract position based in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

e1869a0496b7a4be.description: About the Role Azar Human Resource Solutions is seeking a Sales Representative, Heavy Machinery Spare Parts to join a company specializing in heavy equipment spare parts, with a particular focus on Caterpillar products. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Receive and assist walk-in customers, identify their spare parts needs, and provide accurate product information. Efficiently process sales inquiries, quotations, and orders. Conduct field visits to customers and prospects to promote products and secure new business (outside sales). Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers. Achieve monthly sales targets set by the company. Maintain accurate sales records, invoices, and customer data using computer systems and Excel. Follow up on orders, deliveries, and customer feedback. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales of heavy equipment spare parts, with a preference for Caterpillar products. Solid knowledge of heavy equipment parts and part identification. Good computer skills, particularly with Microsoft Office and Excel. Strong communication, negotiation, and customer service skills. e1c22246d2328dc9.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Design Manager — Civil & Structures to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time leadership position requires over 10 years of experience. The Design Manager will oversee the design and structural engineering functions, manage a team of engineers and designers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality projects that meet all regulatory requirements and client specifications. This role is critical in driving design excellence, innovation, and compliance across the civil and structural engineering portfolio. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage a team of civil and structural engineers and designers, providing mentorship, performance feedback, and professional development opportunities. Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of civil and structural design projects from conception through completion. Ensure all designs comply with Saudi building codes, international standards, and project-specific requirements. Analyze project requirements and develop comprehensive design strategies that balance technical excellence with cost-effectiveness. Manage project budgets, timelines, and resource allocation to ensure efficient project delivery. Coordinate with architects, contractors, clients, and other stakeholders to align design objectives and resolve technical challenges. Review and approve design deliverables, including drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. Implement and maintain quality assurance processes to ensure design accuracy and compliance. Utilize CAD software and Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools to enhance design efficiency and collaboration. Stay current with industry best practices, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes in civil and structural engineering. Prepare and present design proposals, progress reports, and technical presentations to senior management and clients. Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the design team. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in civil and structural engineering design and management. Demonstrated experience in leading design teams and overseeing complex projects. Strong understanding of Saudi building codes and international design standards. Proficiency in CAD software and Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools. Excellent communication, leadership, and project management skills. About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm that partners with clients to solve complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. With over 50,000 professionals worldwide, AECOM delivers projects that create a positive and tangible impact across various sectors, including water, environment, energy, transportation, and buildings. The company is committed to delivering a better world through its advisory, planning, design, engineering, program, and construction management services. Work Environment and Culture At AECOM, employees are part of a global team that supports growth and career ambitions. The company offers opportunities to work on projects that transform the industry and shape the future, both locally and globally. AECOM provides resources such as cutting-edge technology and a network of experts. The workplace fosters respect, collaboration, and community, offering an environment where individuals can grow within a world of opportunity. AECOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

e1c979a73b1af752.description: About the Role Arabian Business Machines is seeking a Sales Specialist to join our team in Makkah, covering both Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role focuses on establishing and maintaining strong customer relationships, managing client requirements, and effectively presenting products and services to meet their needs. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct presentations, product trials, and manage Proof of Concepts (POCs). Develop technical and commercial proposals, presenting offers based on customer scope and requirements. Achieve specified financial targets on a periodic basis. Act as a liaison between end-users, customers, the project management team, and technical support regarding solution and implementation specifics. Provide detailed specifications and Statements of Work (SOW) for customer requests and new requirements. Develop solution architecture and detailed line-item configurations/Bills of Quantities (BOQs). Respond to pre-sales and post-sales customer queries related to product/solution presentation, demonstration, design, and specifications. Candidate Profile We are looking for a professional with a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships. The role requires a candidate who can understand complex customer needs and articulate how our products and services provide optimal solutions. Strong communication and presentation skills are essential for success in this position. Required Experience A minimum of 2 years and a maximum of 5 years of experience in a sales or related specialist role. Demonstrated experience in managing customer accounts and achieving sales targets. Proven ability to conduct product presentations and manage client expectations. Work Location This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, with responsibilities covering both Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves direct interaction with clients across these cities. Application Process If you meet the qualifications and are interested in this opportunity, we encourage you to apply. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

Design and build machine learning models and algorithms tailored to company projects. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems and workflows. Stay current with the latest advances in AI, machine learning, and data science technologies. Support data governance, data quality, and ethical AI practices within the organization. Bachelor’s degree (or recent graduate) in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Basic knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn (academic or personal projects are a plus). Foundational knowledge of statistics, data mining, and predictive modeling concepts. Ability to learn quickly, solve problems, and work collaboratively within a team. e1ef3e477958bdc1.description: About the Role Ilmi is seeking a Shared Services Officer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role serves as the primary coordination point between Ilmi and the Foundation’s Shared Services teams, ensuring efficient handling of requests related to Human Resources, Procurement, and Support Services. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The Shared Services Officer is responsible for ensuring that all service requests are complete, submitted through appropriate channels, and tracked through to closure. This involves monitoring service delivery against agreed requirements and timelines, coordinating with service owners to resolve issues, and escalating delays or service gaps. The role also maintains accurate records, provides management with visibility on service performance, and supports process improvements in line with Ilmi’s operational needs. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary coordination point between Ilmi and the Foundation’s Human Resources, Procurement, and Support Services teams. Review service requests to confirm completeness and accuracy of requirements, supporting documents, and approvals before submission. Maintain a consolidated request tracker, recording owners, submission dates, timelines, dependencies, status, and completion evidence. Proactively follow up with shared services teams and internal request owners to progress requests and resolve issues. Coordinate with Human Resources on recruitment, onboarding, employee services, training administration, and outsourced personnel arrangements. Liaise with Procurement on purchase requisitions, sourcing, vendor documentation, purchase orders, and delivery follow-ups. Coordinate with Support Services for office services, workplace requirements, equipment, and administrative support. Assist employees with shared services processes, systems, forms, and documentation, and resolve access or workflow issues. Monitor request progress against agreed service timelines and SLAs, highlighting items approaching or exceeding completion dates. Identify and escalate delays, bottlenecks, unresolved dependencies, and recurring service gaps to management and relevant service owners. Ensure requests comply with policies, procedures, approved budgets, and delegated approval authorities. Provide regular updates and reports on request volumes, completion status, turnaround times, and outstanding issues. Confirm completion with internal request owners and retain supporting evidence before closing requests. Maintain accurate and confidential records of requests, correspondence, and transactions in approved repositories. Recommend and support improvements to request handling, documentation, coordination, and service delivery. Build effective working relationships with Ilmi employees and Foundation Shared Services stakeholders. Experience and Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in a similar shared services or coordination role. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple requests and priorities effectively. Strong understanding of HR, Procurement, and Support Services processes. Skills and Attributes Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational and record-keeping abilities. Problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Proficiency in using relevant systems and tools for request tracking and management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring close collaboration with internal teams and external shared services providers.

e1feee9707bfb202.description: About the Role PepsiCo is seeking a Sr. Merchandiser to join its sales team in the Makkah region, covering the cities of Taif and Makkah. This full-time position focuses on maximizing product presence and ensuring adherence to merchandising standards within assigned outlets. The role also involves gathering market information to support sales opportunities. Key Responsibilities Execute daily journey plans by calling on specific OT outlets as directed by the supervisor. Merchandise SSFL products across various access points within OT stores, including shelves, stands, and floor displays. Place Point of Sale (POS) materials next to SSFL displays where applicable. Ensure all access points are merchandised according to approved planograms. Rotate products using the FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method and remove sub-standard items. Maintain clean and fresh stock of SSF products on shelves at all times. Monitor and report competitive activities in the market. Report any deviations from agreed terms with assigned OT customers or outlets. Provide daily activity reports for the prior day to the supervisor. Participate in sampling or redemption campaigns as required. Maintain a professional personal appearance and behavior in line with the Frito Lay code of conduct. Role Context and Objectives The primary objective of this role is to enhance PepsiCo's on-shelf presence in all designated outlets. The Sr. Merchandiser will also be responsible for conducting in-store sampling sessions and promotions when necessary. A critical aspect of the role involves ensuring strict adherence to planograms for both on-shelf and off-shelf displays, with any non-compliance reported promptly to the pre-seller. Additionally, the merchandiser will supply the pre-seller with current market information to identify and capitalize on selling opportunities. Performance Measures Execution Standard LTA (Long-Term Agreement) enforcement Journey plan adherence Work Environment This is a full-time position within the sales team, operating in the field across various outlets in Taif and Makkah. The role requires consistent interaction with customers and adherence to daily journey plans.

e144b142dcc09210.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ديار المدينه عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق الحسابات البنكية وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال المحاسبي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتحليل التقارير المالية والمحاسبية. معرفة جيدة بالمعايير المحاسبية والإجراءات المالية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية عالية ودقة في العمل. القدرة على متابعة وتحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتدقيق الحسابات وإعداد التسويات. القدرة على تطوير أساليب العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، وتتطلب الالتزام بالمهام المالية والمحاسبية ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في شركة ديار المدينه. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في المدينة المنورة.

e151bb006180fdb8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مراقب حركة مركبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة مكة المكرمة، بمدينة الطائف. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على حركة المركبات وتوثيق كافة البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بها، مع ضمان الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة والتعليمات الصادرة من الإدارة العليا. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير الأهداف الأساسية لمراقبة حركة المركبات، وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. المشاركة في تنظيم جداول مواعيد وصول ومغادرة المركبات وفقاً للمسارات المحددة، ومراقبة مدى التزام السائقين بها. مراقبة العمليات المتعلقة بالمركبات، بما في ذلك تدوين محتوياتها عند مغادرة المحطات، وحمولتها، وأوزانها، وأرقام سائقي المركبات، ووقت بدء عملهم وانتهائه، مع التأكد من الالتزام بكافة السياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. تدوين كافة التعليمات والأوامر والقرارات الصادرة في السجل المخصص لها، والعمل على إرسالها وتوضيحها للسائقين. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال مراقبة حركة المركبات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تدوين البيانات والمعلومات بدقة واحترافية. فهم جيد للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لحركة المركبات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إدارة الوقت بفعالية. دقة الملاحظة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتوضيح التعليمات للسائقين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيقها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل، وتقع في مدينة الطائف بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يلتزم شاغل الوظيفة بالعمل ضمن فريق لضمان انسيابية حركة المركبات والالتزام بالمعايير التشغيلية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة الوظيفية في مجال مراقبة حركة المركبات.

e1523f1c4438685c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قناص العربية عن أخصائي تغذية سريرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة عسير، وتحديداً في مدينتي أبها وخميس مشيط. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم المشورة الغذائية للمرضى وإعداد برامج تغذية مخصصة بناءً على احتياجاتهم الصحية، بالإضافة إلى إدارة الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالتغذية السريرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة توصيات الأطباء المعالجين لتحديد أنواع الأغذية المناسبة لحالة المريض الصحية وقيمها الغذائية، مع تقدير احتياجاته من السعرات الحرارية. إعداد برامج تغذية فردية للمرضى تتناسب مع حالتهم الصحية. تقييم فعالية البرامج الغذائية المطبقة ومتابعة النتائج المحققة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التغذية السريرية. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالتغذية السريرية في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال التغذية السريرية. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التغذية السريرية. القدرة على تحليل الحالات الصحية للمرضى وتحديد الاحتياجات الغذائية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير وحفظ البيانات. بيئة العمل يُعد هذا الدور وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة قناص العربية، وستكون المهام موزعة بين أبها وخميس مشيط في منطقة عسير. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع المرضى والأطباء لتقديم أفضل رعاية غذائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم الشروط للتقديم على هذه الفرصة ضمن فريق شركة قناص العربية.

e16bf2a73eb28e9f.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Lifeguard - Female to join their team in Riyadh and Ad Dir'iyah. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the safety of swimmers and maintaining a welcoming environment for guests. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Actively observe the swimming area for dangerous conditions, unusual activities, and struggling swimmers. Utilize appropriate rescue techniques when assisting swimmers in need. Promote and enforce the rules and regulations of the recreation facility. Identify situations where guests may not be able to safely participate in an activity and report to a supervisor. Provide initial assistance to injured guests until emergency medical services arrive. Contribute to a fun and relaxing atmosphere for all guests. Manage towels, including obtaining, folding, and stacking according to company procedures. Perform cleaning duties such as washing, mopping, and cleaning the pool deck. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management and complete required safety training and certifications. Adhere to company policies and procedures, maintain confidentiality, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, maintain a professional appearance, anticipate guest needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate clearly and professionally with guests and colleagues. Support co-workers and treat them with dignity and respect. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations, including running, walking, or jogging. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and objects exceeding 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Navigate sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as ladders, stairs, and service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. About The Luxury Collection The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts, part of Marriott International, operates over 120 properties in more than 35 countries. With a history spanning over 100 years, beginning in 1906 under the Italian CIGA brand, The Luxury Collection focuses on providing authentic experiences that create lasting memories. Each hotel and resort is designed to reflect its locale, offering guests a gateway to the destination’s cultural heritage. The brand seeks individuals who appreciate evocative storytelling, have a passion for local heritage, and are committed to delivering genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality. Joining Marriott International By joining The Luxury Collection, you become part of Marriott International's portfolio of brands. This environment supports employees in achieving their best work, fulfilling their purpose, and belonging to a global team, fostering personal and professional growth.

e1718155c8996ded.description: About Ninja Ninja is focused on advancing healthcare and patient interaction. The company is seeking a Pharmacist to join its team, operating on a full-time basis. This role involves dispensing medications and providing personalized patient care and advice. Role Overview The Pharmacist will be responsible for ensuring optimal patient outcomes through accurate medication dispensing and comprehensive counseling. This position requires collaboration with healthcare providers and a commitment to maintaining high standards of pharmacy practice. Key Responsibilities Accurately process and dispense prescription medications, adhering to legal, ethical, and professional standards. Provide medication counseling to patients, addressing questions regarding treatments, side effects, and interactions. Collaborate with healthcare providers to develop and manage patient-specific medication treatment plans. Monitor patient health outcomes and adjust prescriptions as needed in consultation with medical staff. Conduct training sessions for staff and patients on medication safety and wellness. Manage pharmacy inventory to ensure adequate stock levels and minimize waste. Stay updated on new developments in medications and pharmacy practice to enhance service delivery. Qualifications and Experience Doctor of Pharmacy (****** degree from an accredited institution. Active pharmacist license in the state of practice. Minimum of 2 to 5 years of pharmaceutical experience in SA. Strong knowledge of pharmacotherapy and clinical guidelines. Required Skills Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills. Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment. Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Commitment to continuous education and staying current in the pharmacy field. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary information will be disclosed during the interview process.

e176d3e55f27b1fc.description: About the Role Leylaty Group is seeking a Restaurant Receptionist (Saudi) to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves welcoming guests, managing reservations, and ensuring a positive dining experience that aligns with the restaurant's service standards. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to greet guests in a professional and friendly manner, manage table reservations and seating arrangements, and contribute to an exceptional guest experience. The Receptionist ensures that the restaurant's service standards and brand image are consistently upheld. Key Responsibilities Welcome and greet guests upon arrival with a professional demeanor. Manage guest seating arrangements in coordination with the service team. Handle telephone and online reservations, including confirmations and follow-ups. Respond to guest inquiries regarding the menu, prices, services, and operating hours. Manage the waiting list and communicate estimated waiting times to guests. Handle special requests, celebrations, and guest preferences in coordination with relevant departments. Address guest complaints and feedback professionally, resolving issues when possible or escalating them to management. Maintain continuous communication with the Restaurant Manager and service team to ensure smooth operations. Ensure the reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times. Maintain accurate reservation records and guest information. Ensure guests leave with a positive impression by thanking and bidding them farewell. Follow restaurant policies, procedures, and guest service standards. Authority and Accountabilities Organize and coordinate guest seating based on table availability. Manage and confirm guest reservations. Coordinate special guest requests with the relevant departments. Escalate guest complaints and operational issues to the Restaurant Manager. Maintain confidentiality of guest information and reservation records. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in a similar role within the hospitality or restaurant industry. Application Information This is a full-time position with a salary that will be disclosed during the interview process.

e17cbb9bd9ee9497.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدكتور سليمان عبدالقادر فقيه للرعاية الصحية المنزلية عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم رعاية تمريضية متكاملة للمرضى، مع التركيز على تقييم الحالات وتطوير خطط الرعاية وتنفيذها ومتابعتها لضمان أفضل النتائج الصحية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض وجمع البيانات من المريض وذويه وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دقيق. تحديد احتياجات المريض من الرعاية التمريضية، وإعداد خطة رعاية شاملة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بانتظام. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقاً لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية بحسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج، والمشاركة الفعالة في عملية الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل التمريضية ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التمريض والرعاية التمريضية. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي، وضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التمريض. القدرة على تقييم الحالات الصحية بدقة وتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية وأخلاقيات المهنة. موقع العمل ونوع الوظيفة تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص لتقديم أفضل مستويات الرعاية الصحية المنزلية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

e18c0e530ec06434.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع الغدير لمواد التغليف عن عامل فرز منتجات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة العيون. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، ويركز على ضمان سير العمليات التشغيلية بكفاءة ودقة في فرز وتوزيع المواد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فرز المواد وتوزيعها على المناطق المخصصة بناءً على خصائصها مثل الحجم والنوع والحالة والدرجة. تفريغ حاويات المواد التي تم فرزها أو تعديلها حسب الحاجة التشغيلية. تحميل المواد في خطوط الإنتاج أو الأحزمة الناقلة المناسبة لضمان استمرارية عمليات الإنتاج. الحفاظ على نظافة مناطق العمل، وتنظيف الآليات والمعدات والأدوات، وإزالة البقايا والمخلفات بانتظام. تحميل وتفريغ حاويات المنتجات المصنعة. وضع المواد غير المرغوب فيها على الأحزمة الناقلة المخصصة لإزالة النفايات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة والصحة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق تعليمات الفرز والتوزيع بدقة. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في مصنع الغدير لمواد التغليف بمدينة العيون، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق في بيئة إنتاجية، مع التركيز على الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والنظافة. كيفية التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مصنع الغدير لمواد التغليف، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

e121014424489a88.description: About Us Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others. Your role We're seeking a Business Development Specialist for our Commercial team. As a Business Development Specialist, you will be crucial in generating new business opportunities, managing inbound leads, and meeting with existing clients to seek out new clients on behalf of the company. Drawing on your proficiency in establishing rapport, coping with challenges, and concluding transactions, you will be responsible for setting goals and developing plans for business and revenue growth, Researching, planning, and implementing new target market initiatives to create unique experiences only Tamara can provide. With a proven track record of driving revenue growth through business development, sales, or lead generation activities, long-term interest in a client-facing sales career, and ultimately revolutionized the way millions of users shop, pay, and bank. You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges. You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success. Your responsibilities Drive new business by identifying, qualifying, and developing new partnership opportunities for Tamara. Collaborate closely with Partnerships Managers, Partner Success and Marketing teams to strategize creative outreach campaigns and determine priority of outreach based on potential impact. Manage the first stages of the Business Development pipeline by performing initial outreach and nurturing leads through various inbound channels, including phone, email and social media. Drive new client acquisition, revenue and market share in the e-commerce industry to meet / exceed quota. Engage potential partners about their goals and challenges, and educate them on the value of Tamara. Develop best practices and efficient processes for growing our merchant partner base. Contribute significantly to Tamara’s growth as we scale our core business and product. Your expertise Bachelor's degree in a related field. Experience in business development or sales or lead generation, ideally 2+ years of experience. Written and verbal fluency in English; excellent communication skills. Ability to work on data, create insights and PowerPoint presentations for sales pitches.

e199df31ed8fc0f5.description: نبحث عن شريك أعمال موارد بشرية متمكن للعمل كحلقة وصل استراتيجية بين الإدارة والموظفين، والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف العمل وتعزيز الثقافة التنظيمية وتجربة الموظف، مع القدرة على الموازنة بين التخطيط الاستراتيجي والتنفيذ اليومي الفعال. المهام الرئيسية: بناء شراكات استراتيجية مع قادة الإدارات لدعم أهداف العمل. إدارة وحل شؤون وقضايا الموظفين بكفاءة ومهنية. تعزيز الثقافة التنظيمية وتطوير بيئة وتجربة العمل. الشروط والمتطلبات: الجنسية: سعودي / سعودية. الخبرة: من 3 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية. مهارات تواصل عالية وقدرة على التخطيط والتنفيذ العملي.

e1acab96e59eabff.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking an experienced Design Director to manage the design function for a significant ultra-luxury hospitality development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing strategic leadership across multiple design disciplines and ensuring the project's design vision and quality standards are maintained. Key Responsibilities Lead the overall design management strategy and delivery plan for the project. Direct multidisciplinary coordination across architecture, interiors, landscape, structure, MEP, ICT/ELV, FF&E, OS&E, and specialist consultants. Maintain the project’s design vision, luxury positioning, guest experience, and brand standards. Lead design reviews, technical workshops, stage-gate reviews, mock-up reviews, and design audits. Review and approve design deliverables for completeness, coordination, quality, and compliance. Manage interfaces between the client, hotel operator, brand representatives, consultants, contractors, vendors, and authorities. Oversee design development from concept through construction documentation, procurement, installation, testing, and handover. Lead design optimization, constructability reviews, value management, and lifecycle assessments. Monitor design progress, risks, decisions, approvals, dependencies, and change control. Ensure compliance with applicable codes, regulations, authority requirements, sustainability objectives, and project standards. Provide strategic advice to the Project Director and senior client representatives. Lead the resolution of complex design, technical, and interface issues. Support procurement, tender clarification, contractor appointment, and construction-stage design activities. Required Experience and Qualifications Candidates must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in design leadership or a related field. e13fcecb6f6d7b56.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ضواحي الخير للنقل عن سائق حافلة للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة مكة المكرمة، مع إمكانية العمل في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى قيادة الحافلات المخصصة لنقل الحجاج والمعتمرين بأمان واحترافية، وذلك وفقاً لخطط التشغيل والجداول الزمنية المعتمدة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويركز على تقديم خدمات نقل متميزة تضمن راحة وسلامة ضيوف الرحمن، مع الالتزام بالأنظمة والتعليمات المرورية والتنظيمية المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة الحافلة لنقل الحجاج والمعتمرين بين المطارات والفنادق والمشاعر المقدسة والمواقع المحددة وفق خطط التشغيل. الالتزام بمواعيد الرحلات ومسارات النقل المحددة من قبل إدارة التشغيل. التأكد من جاهزية الحافلة وسلامتها الفنية قبل بدء الرحلات، وإجراء الفحص اليومي للمركبة. المحافظة على نظافة الحافلة ومظهرها العام والتأكد من جاهزيتها لاستقبال الركاب. الالتزام بقواعد وأنظمة المرور وتعليمات الجهات المختصة بالنقل والحج والعمرة. التعامل مع الحجاج والمعتمرين باحترام ولباقة، وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة لهم عند الصعود والنزول. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والأمن أثناء نقل الركاب، وعدم تجاوز الحمولة أو السرعات المحددة. الإبلاغ الفوري عن الأعطال الفنية أو الحوادث أو أي ملاحظات تؤثر على سلامة التشغيل. التنسيق المستمر مع مشرفي الحركة والتشغيل بشأن الرحلات ومواعيد التحرك والوصول. التعامل بكفاءة مع ضغط العمل وكثافة الرحلات خلال مواسم الحج والعمرة. المحافظة على ممتلكات الشركة ومركباتها والالتزام بالزي والمظهر المهني المعتمد. الالتزام بالتعليمات الخاصة بتنظيم حركة الحافلات في مكة المكرمة والمدينة المنورة والمشاعر المقدسة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في قيادة الحافلات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قيادة الحافلات بأمان واحترافية. الالتزام بالأنظمة والتعليمات المرورية والتنظيمية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادة ممتازة. القدرة على التعامل مع الركاب بلباقة واحترام. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط خلال مواسم الذروة. مهارات التواصل الفعال. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والأمن. بيئة العمل يعمل سائق الحافلة بدوام كامل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التنقل المستمر بين مكة المكرمة والمدينة المنورة والمشاعر المقدسة. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع مشرفي الحركة والتشغيل لضمان سلاسة الرحلات والالتزام بالجداول الزمنية. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور في شركة ضواحي الخير للنقل يقدم فرصة للمساهمة في خدمة ضيوف الرحمن، ويتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية العالية. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

e1822ee0cc09cb06.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب بصمة تحكم للخدمات التجارية عن مدير تجارة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط وتوجيه استراتيجيات التسويق الإلكتروني، وتحديد الفرص الجديدة، والإشراف على تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء الرئيسيين والحفاظ عليها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع استراتيجيات التسويق الإلكتروني بالتعاون مع الإدارة العليا وفرق التسويق، وابتكار أساليب لتحسين صورة العلامة التجارية. إدارة فرق التجارة الإلكترونية والإشراف على تخطيط وتنفيذ برامج التسويق. تنسيق تنفيذ الحملات الترويجية والإعلانات والإصدارات الصحفية واتصالات العلامة التجارية والأنشطة المشابهة. إدارة تخطيط وتنفيذ أبحاث التجارة الإلكترونية. الإشراف على جمع وتحليل البيانات المتعلقة بالمستهلكين والمنافسين والعوامل الأخرى ذات الصلة بأعمال التجارة الإلكترونية. وضع السياسات والإجراءات الخاصة بفرق التجارة الإلكترونية والإشراف على تطبيقها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه استراتيجيات التسويق الإلكتروني. مهارات قوية في إدارة الفرق وتنسيق الأنشطة التسويقية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتحديد الفرص الجديدة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المكتب للمساهمة في بيئة عمل تعاونية وموجهة نحو تحقيق الأهداف. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور يوفر فرصة للمساهمة في نمو وتطوير استراتيجيات التجارة الإلكترونية لمكتب بصمة تحكم للخدمات التجارية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

e1386c7a8805fa3e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البكار الدولية عن فني أشعة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية، وإعداد المرضى، وتشغيل الأجهزة لضمان الحصول على صور شعاعية دقيقة وواضحة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وصيانة أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة السينية بشكل دوري. تأمين ومراقبة مخزون مستلزمات التصوير، مثل الأفلام والأدوية اللازمة. تطبيق إجراءات الوقاية الشخصية لضمان السلامة المهنية. تنظيم وتنسيق مواعيد المرضى بكفاءة. مرافقة المرضى إلى غرفة التصوير، وتحديد أجزاء الجسم المراد تصويرها، وتحديد طبيعة الصورة الشعاعية ومواصفات الأشعة المطلوبة بناءً على طلب الطبيب. تثبيت ألواح الرصاص لحماية الأجزاء الجسدية التي يجب ألا تتعرض للأشعة. توجيه وضبط أجهزة التصوير، واختيار مدة وشدة التعرض للأشعة، والتقاط الصور الشعاعية. إظهار وتثبيت الصور الشعاعية، وتضمين المعلومات الأساسية عليها، وتقديمها لأخصائي الأشعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التصوير بالأشعة. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والوقاية من الإشعاع. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة المواعيد وسير العمل. دقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد الصور والتقارير. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع المرضى والزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأشعة ضمن فريق شركة البكار الدولية في المدينة المنورة، في بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

e1e416c6dec7b690.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رؤية للصناعة عن أخصائي استثمار للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تحليل المعلومات والبيانات المالية لدعم قرارات الاستثمار، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالاستثمار وعرضها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد النماذج المالية الشاملة من البداية إلى النهاية، بما في ذلك نماذج القوائم المالية الثلاث المتكاملة للفرص الاستثمارية. قيادة تحليلات التقييم باستخدام منهجيات التدفقات النقدية المخصومة (DCF)، والتقييم بناءً على السوق، والتقييم القائم على الأصول. تقييم الاستثمارات في حقوق الملكية من خلال إجراء تحليلات دقيقة للعوائد والمخاطر باستخدام مؤشرات مثل معدل العائد الداخلي (IRR)، وصافي القيمة الحالية (NPV)، ومضاعف رأس المال المستثمر (MOIC). إعداد مذكرات الاستثمار، ودراسات الجدوى وحالات الأعمال التفصيلية، والعروض التقديمية الموجهة للإدارة التنفيذية. إجراء تحليلات الحساسية والسيناريوهات المختلفة لاختبار مدى تحمل النتائج الاستثمارية للتغيرات والافتراضات المختلفة. تحليل ديناميكيات السوق، واتجاهات القطاعات، والاعتبارات والمتطلبات التنظيمية ذات الصلة. التعاون مع الفرق الفنية والتجارية والقانونية لضمان توفير مدخلات وتحليلات متكاملة وموثوقة وجاهزة لدعم اتخاذ القرارات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 7 سنوات في إعداد النماذج المالية وتحليل الاستثمارات. درجة البكالوريوس في المالية أو المحاسبة أو أي تخصص ذي صلة. يفضل الحصول على شهادة CFA أو ACCA. يفضل وجود خبرة في أحد القطاعات التالية: الطاقة، النفط والغاز، التصنيع، البنية التحتية، أو الطاقة المتجددة. المهارات الأساسية مهارات قوية في إعداد النماذج المالية. إتقان استخدام برنامج PowerPoint. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل أخصائي الاستثمار ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم الأهداف الاستثمارية للشركة.

e1ed12b88db59c6e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. وضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشروعات. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح نظم التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. متطلبات الخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. فهم جيد لعمليات تصميم نظم التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. القدرة على وضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشروعات. الصحة والسلامة المهنية يجب على الفني الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في المؤسسة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومطابقة للمعايير. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات في مدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم للوظيفة للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الفرصة في مجال التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف.

e1e5c5b6750ee9c0.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Manager, Residential Marketing Portfolio to lead the strategic marketing direction and portfolio planning for its residential assets and developments. e13deae773ba5865.description: The professional development team at Nama Partners works with individuals and teams within companies to build capabilities that endure long after the assignment concludes. This role begins with a simple observation: most of the training teams receive does not change how they work after two weeks. About the Role We are looking for a Professional Development Trainer to design and deliver training sessions for small groups within client organizations, while monitoring the impact of the training on participant performance. From day one, you will carry responsibility for at least one training module and work with a Partner to identify the gap before writing any content. This is an Associate-level role, suitable for someone with a foundation in training or professional development—whether through studies, internships, or side projects—who wishes to build upon it within a consulting firm. About Nama Partners Nama Partners is a strategic consulting firm that works primarily with entities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and companies with significant interests there. Our work covers corporate strategy, growth, market entry, operating models, efficiency, organization, talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, governance, and risk. We handle issues that do not fit the large firm model, such as a succession question in a boardroom or a family decision regarding bringing in an outside investor. The Partners who define the scope of work participate in its execution, and collaboration often continues after the recommendation is presented. Tasks and Responsibilities Identify the training gap with the client team before designing any session and write the scope notes that will be relied upon. Prepare training materials, exercises, and case studies, phrasing them in the participants' daily business language rather than textbook language. Deliver sessions remotely using the video conferencing tools agreed upon with the client, and manage the discussion within the group. Collect participant feedback after each session and summarize it in a short memo clarifying what has changed and what has not. Follow up on the impact of the training weeks after its conclusion through short calls with supervisors, and provide a proposal to improve the next module. Build a library of reusable training materials on topics of organization, talent, and performance improvement. Required Qualifications We require a basic knowledge of training principles and instructional design, gained from studies, a training program, a summer internship, or side work. This knowledge is sufficient to start, and we will build the rest with you. Beside this, we expect clear communication in speech and writing, attention to detail when preparing material, and punctuality with clients. The job requires organizing your time between two or three tasks per week and the ability to work remotely on a regular basis without daily supervision. Fluency in Arabic is required as most sessions and materials are in Arabic. Knowledge of English is an added advantage, as is any previous experience in training within a company, association, or student group. What Good Performance Means After six to twelve months, we want you to have a set of ready-made sessions suitable for more than one client, and for a supervisor at a client organization to say that their team is now using a specific tool or principle we introduced in the training. We track the result through the follow-up calls you conduct, participant feedback, and supervisor reports. Good performance means that your memos show a clear opinion rather than just a narrative of the session events, and that you know when material is unsuitable and suggest an alternative early on. How We Make Decisions A Partner defines the scope of each task and approves the training material before it is presented to the client. You prepare the material, present it, and manage the session, and reviewing it is part of the workflow, not an exception. When you find that your opinion on any session contradicts what was agreed upon, you propose the adjustment in that same week, not after the training is finished, and the discussion reaches the principle quickly. We rely on your judgment in the details of the delivery and in addressing participant objections, and this judgment is what we rely on when evaluating our work and developing it. What the Role Offers This is a permanent, full-time role, where the person works remotely, with the company headquarters in Riyadh. You will interact directly with the client team and see how questions are posed within a large organization and how its decisions are made. The experience available here is in understanding the Kingdom’s institutions from the inside, starting from evaluating their employees and workflows. You work with a Partner on every task, learning how to turn an idea into training material. How We Work We take a limited number of tasks at a time and plan for them before starting. Daily communication within the team is clear, and documented decisions make remote work possible: who owns the decision, what we are waiting for, and when it arrives. Those who succeed here usually have a habit of writing and reviewing before presenting and feel comfortable in a training room where objections are expected, even if the room is a screen. Those who succeed also know the name of the person who needs information and contact them, deal with ambiguous issues using the client's language, and verify their numbers whenever possible before relying on them.

e18a17a9b7992e03.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is developing Qiddiya, a new global destination for entertainment, sports, and culture in Riyadh Province. The company is building a vibrant new city that will offer diverse experiences to residents and visitors. Role Overview The Senior Manager - Fire and Life Safety Operation will oversee all fire prevention, life safety, and emergency preparedness operations across Qiddiya's city assets. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, ensures that fire safety systems, evacuation procedures, and life safety protocols meet international standards to safeguard guests, employees, and infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Oversee the operational readiness and performance of all fire detection, suppression, and alarm systems across Qiddiya's portfolio of assets. Develop, implement, and maintain fire safety and life safety management plans, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and emergency evacuation procedures. Conduct regular fire risk assessments, safety audits, and inspections to ensure compliance with Saudi Civil Defence regulations and international best practices. Coordinate fire safety training programs, evacuation drills, and awareness campaigns for operational staff and tenant stakeholders. Liaise with Saudi Civil Defence, local fire authorities, and third-party consultants on regulatory compliance, permitting, and emergency response coordination. Lead incident investigations related to fire or life safety events, producing root cause analyses and corrective action plans. Support the design review and commissioning of fire and life safety systems for new and existing assets to ensure operational readiness. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 7+ years of experience in fire safety management, life safety operations, or fire engineering within large-scale mixed-use developments, theme parks, or entertainment destinations. In-depth knowledge of NFPA codes, Saudi Building Code, Civil Defense requirements, and international fire safety standards. Professional certifications such as NEBOSH Fire Safety, IFE membership, or equivalent are strongly preferred. Proven leadership experience managing fire safety teams and coordinating with regulatory authorities. Strong analytical skills with experience conducting fire risk assessments and safety audits. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

e18b2bac0e2d26d8.description: About the Role ASMO is seeking an SCM Process Engineer for its Spark site in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves designing, optimizing, implementing, and sustaining warehouse and logistics processes. The engineer will translate operational requirements into effective workflows, system requirements, and standardized working methods to ensure measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, inventory accuracy, and customer service. Key Responsibilities Map, analyze, and improve end-to-end warehouse and logistics processes, including inbound receiving, inspection, put-away, inventory control, replenishment, picking, packing, staging, loading, returns, and exception handling. Translate operational requirements and customer needs into practical process designs, standardized working methods, procedures, and work instructions. Conduct workflow analysis, time studies, capacity assessments, and root-cause analysis to identify bottlenecks, waste, and process constraints. Identify, develop, and implement site-level process improvements, and support the deployment of wider logistics concepts from the Supply Chain & Logistics function. Evaluate improvement proposals based on operational benefit, feasibility, risk, cost, and implementation effort. Translate operational issues and improvement requirements into clear business and functional requirements for BY-WMS, TMS, and related logistics systems. Verify that system processes, controls, and exception handling are practical and consistently followed by operational teams. Support investigation and resolution of process or system disruptions in coordination with operations, inventory control, and IT. Monitor improvement benefits against approved baselines and targets, including productivity, quality, inventory accuracy, lead time, and service performance. Analyze and report process deviations, root causes, corrective actions, implementation progress, and benefits achieved against approved targets. Present findings, recommended actions, and implementation results to site management and relevant operational stakeholders. Project Leadership Lead assigned site-level process-improvement projects from problem definition through design, pilot, implementation, stabilization, and formal handover to operations. Define project scope, objectives, baseline, milestones, action owners, risks, expected benefits, and implementation requirements. Coordinate improvement activities across inbound, outbound, inventory, quality, logistics, IT, and other relevant functions. Develop implementation and change plans for new or modified processes. Training and Documentation Develop and deliver process training, operational instructions, and refresher training for new and existing employees affected by process changes. Establish process controls, audit criteria, and performance measures before handover. Conduct post-implementation reviews to confirm adoption, performance, and sustainability. Correct implementation gaps and ensure procedures and work instructions remain current. Continuous Improvement and Compliance Contribute to continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices to increase productivity, operational control, and efficiency. Implement relevant Supply Chain & Logistics policies, processes, procedures, and instructions to ensure work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Ensure process changes and documentation remain aligned with applicable safety, quality, and operational requirements. Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in SCM process engineering or a related field. Demonstrated ability to design, optimize, and implement warehouse and logistics processes. Experience with BY-WMS or similar logistics systems is preferred. Strong analytical skills to identify bottlenecks and root causes. Proven project management skills for leading process improvement initiatives.

e195f5b9601167a7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مايند القابضة عن مدير تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يتولى مدير التسويق مسؤولية الإشراف المباشر على أنشطة تخطيط وإدارة التسويق، بما يضمن توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية للشركة. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان توفر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية عالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف والسياسات والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية المتعلقة بالتسويق. متابعة الخطط التسويقية لضمان كفاءتها وفعاليتها، ووضع أطر ومقاييس دقيقة لقياس مستوى تحقيق الأهداف. تطوير الخطط التسويقية السنوية والخطط الإعلانية والبرامج الترويجية بالتنسيق مع الوحدات التنظيمية والجهات ذات العلاقة. الإشراف على تنفيذ الخطط التسويقية والإعلامية، وضمان تطبيقها وفقاً للإجراءات والمواعيد والميزانيات المحددة، مع التأكد من فعاليتها في تحقيق أهداف الشركة التسويقية. بناء علاقات استراتيجية مع الشركاء الخارجيين مثل شركات الإعلان، والتعاون معهم لإعداد ونشر المواد التسويقية والإعلانات الخاصة بالشركة ووحداتها التابعة. الإشراف على إعداد الدراسات التسويقية ومتابعة توزيع الكتيبات والمطبوعات والمواد التسويقية الأخرى المتعلقة بالشركة وخدماتها، وضمان نشرها وتوزيعها بما يخدم الأهداف التسويقية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التسويق. القدرة على وضع الأهداف والسياسات والخطط التشغيلية. مهارات إشرافية ممتازة لإدارة فرق وأنشطة التسويق. القدرة على ضمان توفر الموارد اللازمة لسير العمليات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية، ضمن فريق عمل ديناميكي في شركة مايند القابضة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

e1b6e24317a519be.description: About the Role UCC Holding is seeking a QA/QC Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Region. This full-time role is essential for ensuring that all work and projects adhere to established good work practices and project specifications, consistently meeting or exceeding client expectations. The QA/QC Engineer will be responsible for implementing international quality standards and procedures across all construction activities. Role Overview The primary objective of this position is to maintain high-quality standards throughout construction projects. The QA/QC Engineer will play a key role in developing and refining the Project Quality Management System by establishing necessary procedures, plans, and work instructions. This involves a proactive approach to quality assurance and control, ensuring compliance from material inspection to final project delivery. Key Responsibilities Assist the Project QA/QC Manager or Sr. QA/QC Engineer in implementing the quality management system at the site. Prepare and submit Work Inspection Requests (WIR) for each construction activity to the consultant. Verify all incoming materials against project specifications and approved material submittals. Monitor WIRs and test reports, providing status updates to the Quality Manager and site team. Establish and oversee the control of QA/QC Plans, Method Statements, and Test Plans. Ensure document control procedures are implemented and approved documents are properly distributed. Check Inspection and Test Plans, confirming that method statements and test plans are submitted according to the approved ITP. Verify that work inspections are conducted as planned and advise the construction team on necessary corrective actions. Perform internal material inspections before consultant inspection and issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) to suppliers for substandard materials. Maintain comprehensive records of all work and material inspections, providing data for weekly progress meetings. Record test results and ensure the availability of steel mill certificates and test logs. Support Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant QA/QC role. Demonstrated understanding of international quality standards and construction quality procedures. Ability to prepare and manage quality documentation, including WIRs, ITPs, and NCRs. Strong attention to detail for material and work inspections. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the QA/QC Engineer will work closely with project managers, site teams, and consultants to uphold quality standards across various construction activities. The role requires active participation in site operations and adherence to safety protocols.

e1337a3f8faa0f7e.job_title: Kids Club Manager - Fairmont The Red Sea

e18dafaecbc8e05f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدلتا السعوديه للصناعات الكيماويه عن عامل فرز منتجات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على فرز المواد المختلفة خلال مراحل الإنتاج وضمان الحفاظ على نظافة منطقة العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فرز المواد وتوزيعها على المناطق المخصصة بناءً على خصائصها مثل الحجم والنوع والحالة والدرجة. تفريغ حاويات المواد التي تم فرزها أو تغييرها حسب متطلبات العمل. تحميل المواد في خطوط الإنتاج أو الأحزمة الناقلة المناسبة لضمان استمرارية عمليات الإنتاج. الحفاظ على نظافة مناطق العمل، بما في ذلك تنظيف الآليات والمعدات والأدوات، وإزالة البقايا والمخلفات. تحميل وتفريغ حاويات المنتجات المصنعة. وضع المواد غير المرغوب فيها على الأحزمة الناقلة المخصصة لإزالة النفايات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة والصحة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن بيئة إنتاجية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بجدول العمل المحدد لضمان سير العمليات الإنتاجية بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

e180498ab9a71a3a.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Manager, Cost Planning to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for supporting Qiddiya's cost planning requirements within assigned business units, development projects, and governance activities. The Senior Manager will provide structured cost planning support, coordinate with consultants, contribute to Stage Gate reviews, conduct benchmarking analysis, and assist with cost governance to ensure project budgets, cost plans, and design-to-budget decisions are evidence-based, consistent, and aligned with Qiddiya's standards. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to support General Business Unit Cost Planning in applying consistent cost planning standards across Qiddiya's business units and development assets. The Senior Manager will ensure that cost planning activities are well-coordinated, consultant outputs are reviewed according to agreed requirements, Stage Gate submissions include necessary cost planning information, and business units receive clear, reliable, and evidence-based cost planning support throughout the asset lifecycle. While detailed cost plans may be prepared by external consultants, the Senior Manager is responsible for reviewing outputs, coordinating comments, maintaining records, and escalating key issues for leadership review. Key Accountabilities Coordinate cost planning activities for assigned projects, workstreams, business unit support, and development programs. Support the implementation of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, templates, trackers, reporting standards, and governance processes. Review and provide comments on cost consultant outputs, including cost plans, reconciliations, assumptions, risk allowances, benchmarks, cost reports, and design-to-budget recommendations. Maintain clear and current cost planning records for assigned projects, workstreams, or business unit support areas. Support Stage Gate reviews by verifying cost planning readiness, completeness, compliance, and alignment with required deliverables. Coordinate with internal teams (business units, development, design, commercial, procurement, finance, project controls, digital) and external consultants to achieve integrated cost planning outcomes. Provide early-stage cost advice, feasibility input, benchmark checks, and pre-concept cost planning as needed before the appointment of project cost consultants. Assist with the briefing, mobilization, coordination, and performance monitoring of executive and project cost consultants. Track scope and cost movements across project phases, escalating material changes, risks, opportunities, and non-compliance issues in a timely and structured manner. Apply benchmarking data, cost planning software, digital tools, and cost planning analytics to support the review and validation of cost positions. Support business unit cost planning capability through training, onboarding, guidance, and adoption of Qiddiya's ways of working. Contribute to the preparation of cost planning review packs, governance papers, leadership updates, dashboards, and trackers. Promote consistent ways of working, professional standards, and continuous improvement within the cost planning community. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in cost planning or a related field. Demonstrated reliability and a delivery-focused approach, with strong ownership of assigned tasks. Professional and constructive approach when reviewing information, raising issues, and participating in cost planning discussions. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret cost, design, benchmark, and risk information effectively. Clear communication skills, capable of preparing structured comments, summaries, trackers, and updates. Collaborative and responsive when working with internal stakeholders and external consultants. Adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving development environment. Committed to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and strengthening Qiddiya's cost planning capabilities. Performance and Success Measures Success in this role will be measured by the maintenance of clear, current, and evidence-based cost planning records for assigned projects, and the timely checking, coordination, and submission of Stage Gate cost planning deliverables in line with Qiddiya requirements. Key indicators include the thorough review of consultant-produced cost plans with clear comments and actions, prompt identification and escalation of material cost movements, risks, scope changes, and non-compliance issues. Consistent application of cost planning guidelines, templates, and reporting processes, along with effective use of benchmarking data and analytics, are also critical. Timely and practical cost planning support to business units and project teams, effective coordination and monitoring of consultant deliverables, and positive stakeholder feedback reflecting collaboration and professional support are essential for success. Application Candidates who meet the qualifications and are prepared to contribute to Qiddiya's cost planning objectives are encouraged to apply.

e1f18173628d01fa.job_title: Data Management and Governance Senior Consultant
e1f18173628d01fa.description: About the Role Cyberani by Aramco Digital is seeking a Senior Data Management Consultant to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves delivering and establishing data management programs and assessments for clients, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and organizational objectives. The Senior Consultant will develop essential data management frameworks, data governance practices, data protection policies, and data lifecycle processes to enhance data usability, consistency, integrity, and security for clients. Key Responsibilities Assess clients’ alignment and compliance with national and international data regulations, standards, and policies, including those from the National Data Management Office. Evaluate clients’ personal data protection practices in compliance with applicable regulations, ensuring secure collection, storage, and usage of personal data. Conduct requirements gathering and business analysis to identify client needs in data governance, data management, privacy, and regulatory compliance. Develop tailored data governance frameworks, policies, standards, operating models, processes, and accountability structures to strengthen data ownership and stewardship. Design data management strategies, roadmaps, and target operating models aligned with business objectives, regulatory obligations, and industry best practices. Assess data management maturity, identify improvement opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to enhance governance effectiveness. Evaluate data-related risks, including those related to data governance, privacy, quality, security, and master data, and recommend appropriate controls and mitigation measures. Support clients in establishing data lifecycle management practices, covering effective data creation, usage, storage, retention, and disposal. Develop practical procedures, playbooks, and governance guidance for data owners, stewards, and business stakeholders. Deliver high-quality reports, presentations, maturity assessments, and strategic roadmaps with clear and actionable outcomes. Collaborate with project teams and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of project objectives, deliverables, and timelines. Manage assigned project activities, deliverables, and client communications to ensure quality and timely execution. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology/Systems, Computer Science, Data Management, or a related field. A minimum of 6 years of experience in cybersecurity and data governance. Demonstrated exposure to data management, data governance, risk management, and compliance processes. Experience in implementing enterprise data governance and master data management frameworks. Experience in reviewing data management policies, procedures, and controls. Familiarity with establishing and/or operating data management office(s). Familiarity with conducting or supporting risk and gap assessments against industry frameworks such as NDMO, COBIT, NCA, or ISO 8000. Basic understanding of data management principles and governance. Required Skills Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

e1fe33d44247dc24.description: Eram Talent is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Reporting Lead to manage and drive the reporting activities for the Capital Renewal Program in Saudi Arabia. The Reporting Lead is responsible for overseeing program-wide reporting, analytics, and executive visibility for the Capital Renewal Program at KAUST. This role ensures the delivery of accurate, timely, and actionable insights across all projects, supporting leadership in strategic decision-making, governance, and execution. The role acts as a critical link between project teams and executive management by consolidating data, managing reporting frameworks, and driving continuous improvement in reporting processes, dashboards, and program integration. Lead the design, development, and delivery of regular and ad-hoc reports related to the Capital Renewal Program. Collaborate with project managers, finance, and other stakeholders to define reporting requirements and KPIs. Develop, implement, and maintain standardized reporting frameworks covering scope, cost, schedule, risks, and KPIs, ensuring governance, accuracy, and consistency. Consolidate project data into weekly, monthly, and quarterly executive reports, delivering timely and actionable insights for leadership. Establish and enforce reporting protocols, including timelines, validation workflows, and approval processes across all project teams. Track and manage interdependencies across projects, ensuring alignment with operational priorities and funding cycles. Identify and communicate cross-project risks, delays, and resource conflicts, providing impact assessments and mitigation strategies. Design and maintain executive dashboards, offering real-time visibility into program progress, budget utilization, schedule performance, and key risks. Review and validate master schedules, monitor critical path and dependencies, and proactively address slippages with recovery plans. Drive continuous improvement by enhancing reporting tools, templates, and processes while promoting best practices in planning, scheduling, and program reporting. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, or related field. Professional certification such as PMP is preferred. Certification in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage. Minimum 7+ years of experience in project reporting, program management, or capital project oversight. Experience in managing reporting frameworks and executive dashboards. Strong understanding of project lifecycle, governance, and reporting processes. Experience in schedule management and critical path analysis. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) and SAP. Experience with dashboarding and analytics tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and mathematical skills.
